measurement_notes.pack_e: Backward 40-line scan from each 'question_state: Certified' to nearest preceding 'QuestionID'. 9 of 500 items have QID >40 lines from state (likely very large Object blocks). These 9 were not assigned to a section but contribute to the 500 total. Sections C and D are the most likely destinations for these unmatched items (given their 96/100 and 70/75 observed counts vs. expected 100 and 75).
measurement_notes.pack_a: Dual-block architecture (Block 1 metadata + Block 2 content). Context-30 forward scan from QuestionID matched both blocks. Since only Block 1 has question_state, no double-counting occurred (sum 481 matches expected).
measurement_notes.pack_c_d: Backward 40-line scan confirmed all totals. Packs C and D use the same dual-block architecture as Pack A. QID prefixes are 2-letter (P1-AC-, P1-BC-, etc.). Section mapping: first letter after P1- is the section.
measurement_notes.pack_b: Forward context-30 scan worked perfectly — QuestionID and question_state are adjacent in Pack B's single-object format. 500/500 confirmed.
